entities.name: Tel-Jilad
entities.description: The Tree of Tales, once the largest tree in the Tangle on Mirrodin, inscribed with Mirrodin's history; obliterated in the Phyrexian invasion.

entities.name: Viridian elves
entities.description: Elves who mostly rejected Tel-Jilad after the fifth sun dawned.

entities.name: Thrun
entities.description: Troll elder who escaped the destruction with his people's knowledge.

events.summary: Tel-Jilad and surrounding settlements are obliterated in the Phyrexian invasion, but troll elder Thrun escapes with his people's knowledge.
events.quote: one troll elder, Thrun , escaped with his people's knowledge intact

relations.quote: the largest of the trees in the Tangle on Mirrodin
